goal: Stop corrupted wallet transaction records from triggering an endless full chain rescan on every startup
Prevent wallets from running in a degraded state with missing spend and conflict tracking
reviewability: Wait for the author to address an open objection about swapped hashes in the error message
agreement: General support for failing fast on corruption instead of attempting unreliable rescans
Unaddressed objection: stored and actual hashes are swapped in the error message (jeanpablojp)
Nonblocking objection: users without backups are locked out of uncorrupted funds (polespinasa)
Verified by reproducing corruption and testing the failure path on regtest (jeanpablojp)

categories.name: wallet
why: P2 because it prevents wallets from silently running with corrupt records and missing spend tracking
It spares affected users from repeated, futile chain rescans from genesis on every load
